subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir texto sobre tema de interesse, organizando resultados de pesquisa em fontes de informação impressas ou digitais, incluindo imagens e gráficos ou tabelas, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto.

components.description_pt: Planejar texto sobre tema de interesse organizando achados de pesquisa de fontes impressas ou digitais
components.description_en: Plan a text on a topic of interest by organizing research findings from print or digital sources

cc_matches.description: Conduct short research projects that build knowledge about a topic.
Integrate quantitative or technical information expressed in words in a text with a version of that information expressed visually (e.g., in a flowchart, diagram, model, graph, or table).

Recall relevant information from experiences or gather relevant information from print and digital sources; summarize or paraphrase information in notes and finished work, and provide a list of sources.
